visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male and female host stand in front of a grand European stone building with large arched windows. The male host wears a white jacket and glasses, raising his hand in a peace sign, while the female host in a white dress waves at the camera. Yellow and blue graphic overlays appear at the top and bottom. (2) A series of quick cuts shows various European landmarks: a bronze statue of a rider against a yellow building, an aerial view of a castle on a hill overlooking a lake, and the hosts walking towards a white palace under a cloudy sky. (3) The hosts are seen in front of a Gothic-style cathedral with intricate stone carvings. They wave enthusiastically. (4) The scene shifts to a boat on a river; the hosts sit at a table with glasses of beer and wine, toasting to the camera as the city skyline passes behind them. (5) An aerial drone shot captures a stunning turquoise lake with wooden walkways and cascading waterfalls surrounded by lush greenery. Many tourists are walking on the paths. (6) The hosts explore the interior of a massive limestone cave, pointing at the impressive stalactites and stalagmites under warm artificial lighting. (7) The male host is in a dark wine cellar with illuminated bottles on tiered shelves. He and the female host are then shown tasting red wine in a modern bar setting. (8) Close-up shots of food are shown, including a plated steak with asparagus and mash, followed by the female host taking a bite of bread and looking delighted. (9) The hosts walk down a hotel hallway and open a door to reveal a modern suite with a large bed, a sitting area, and a balcony overlooking a green valley. (10) The video concludes with the hosts in a city square, gesturing as text overlays regarding the tour price appear. A staff member in a hat and mask joins them briefly in the background.

The male and female hosts introduce the travel tour with high energy and rising intonations. (2) A 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the first location subtitle. The hosts' voices are layered over the continuous BGM. (3) A 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as the scene cuts to a new location. Background wind and distant outdoor chatter are faintly audible beneath the narration. (4) Sound of glasses clinking accompanies the hosts' toast. The music continues without interruption. (5) In the cave sequence, the acoustics become slightly reverberant, matching the large indoor space. The female host lets out an excited exclamation. (6) A sharp 'pop' SFX triggers as the variety text '看到了會瘋掉' appears. The music tempo remains steady. (7) During the food segment, a subtle crunching sound is heard as the host eats, followed by a 'ding' SFX. (8) The final phase features a group laughter effect and a 'glitch' SFX transition as the tour price is revealed. The BGM swells slightly in volume toward the end before a quick fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Showcase -> Experience Highlights (Food, Hotel, Wine) -> Price Reveal -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a specific 10-day travel package to four Eastern European countries (Croatia, Slovenia, Austria, Hungary) offered by Settour (東南旅遊), emphasizing high value (CP ratio), luxury experiences like Michelin-recommended food and 4-star hotels, and an affordable price point.
